source_text: Apostolus dicit velamen auferri conversis ad Dominum. Indumenta pontificis non nudam historiam sed mysteria Christi et ecclesiae tegunt.
pass_a_gloss: Apostle says veil to-be-taken-away to-ones-turned to Lord. Garments of-high-priest not bare history but mysteries of-Christ and of-church cover.
pass_b_english: The Apostle says the [[veil is taken away for those who turn to the Lord >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:16]]. The high priest’s garments are not bare history; they veil mysteries of Christ and the church.
